title: Your monthly royalty report shouldn’t start from scratch.
body: Keep the process. Update the numbers.

title: But scattered files make your team repeat the same search.
body: Statements here. Contracts there. Context in someone’s inbox.

title: Bring those inputs together before introducing AI.
body: Agree which sources to use and where they live.

title: Then let AI prepare a draft for your team to review.
body: Check the numbers against the original sources.

title: Test that process on one real report and fix the gaps.
body: Use a completed report to compare the results.

title: Next month, reuse the process instead of rebuilding it.
body: Carry forward what worked. Improve what didn’t.
